findings.B1: Sticky preset search is painted over and intercepted by cards in Want, Method, Value, Boundary.
findings.B2: Refresh gives no unchanged feedback; goal changes affect hidden questions while visible three remain unchanged.
findings.B3: Scene context action gap is zero; equivalent World action pair runs together.
findings.B4: Recovery notice obscures actual prose lines and mobile editor controls.
findings.B5: Opening Outline tools/palette is forgotten on plot switch or palette action.
findings.B6: Reload changes Master to A Plot, hiding Master-only work until lens is reopened.
findings.B7: No-viewpoint Explorer sentences give a scene human cognition.
findings.B9: Legacy Explorer disclosure is 21px high with insufficient adjacent target spacing.
findings.D1: Account interface is undifferentiated full-screen connection/recovery console.
findings.D2: Explorer question cards do not justify their footprint or interaction cost.
findings.D3: Long repeated introductory and advisory copy competes with writing and character blocks.
findings.D4: Responsive shell, forms and action hierarchy spend too much vertical space on small screens.
findings.D5: Redraws, hidden actions and weak feedback disrupt satisfying interaction.

decisions: Remove runtime Scene Explorer question panel and redundant entry points; retain authored possibilities, legacy drafts, scene approaches and context-bearing scene creation.
Make Outline MICE palette, plot lens and view switches visible and stable; restore per-project selected lens.
Use conventional Account dialog with grouped identity/status, recovery, saved-work actions; preserve unfinished editor on return.
Remove sticky preset search overlap with simpler normal-flow search; fix shared action spacing.
Keep routine recovery reminder in Account; reserve space for urgent save failures without covering writing.
Reduce repeated advisory copy, duplicate help and identity entry points; improve compact responsive layout while preserving all workflows.
Correct contrast, target size, focus visibility and motion behavior; verify interactive outcomes.
Preserve schema, unknown legacy metadata, histories, references, exports, recovery, conflict copies and optional storytelling structure.
After approval implement, test, push GitHub PR, checks, merge, delete branch, verify live, then re-present user instructions verbatim.
verification_limits: Live authenticated paths blocked by unavailable registration code; user authorized local testing.
